channel.title: STLACCESS Guides — 3D Print Miniature Scale Conversion

item.title: Best Budget 3D Printers for Tabletop Wargaming — FDM Terrrain & Vehicle Guide

item.title: How to Scale 28mm to 32mm (114.3% Slicer Percentage, Explained)
item.description: What percent for 28mm to 32mm? 114.3% with XYZ locked. The math behind the conversion, the exact slicer steps for Chitubox, Lychee, Cura, and PrusaSlicer, and how to verify it on a test print.

item.title: How to Downscale 32mm to 28mm (87.5% Slicer Percentage, Explained)
item.description: Shrink 32mm miniatures down to true 28mm scale with an 87.5% slicer percentage. Fits more minis on a resin plate and mixes D&D proxies into true-scale armies.

item.title: D&D Miniature Scale Guide — What Size Are D&D Minis?
item.description: What scale is D&D? Medium humanoids are 28mm to the eyes on the 175cm baseline. The full D&D size chart: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gargantuan with mini heights and base sizes.

item.title: Star Wars: Legion Scale Guide — What Scale Are Legion Miniatures?
item.description: Star Wars: Legion miniatures are 35mm scale (1:47), measured to eye level at 35.7mm. Full height about 40mm. Exact slicer percentages to convert Legion STLs and proxies.

item.title: How to Measure a Miniature's Scale: Eye Level vs Top of Head Explained
item.description: How I measure miniature scale for 3D printing — eye level vs top of head, digital calipers, and why the 175cm baseline works.

item.title: FDM Miniature Printing: Complete Guide to Layer Height, Nozzles, and Settings
item.description: Best FDM settings for tabletop miniatures — nozzles, layer heights, orientation tips, and post-processing for 28mm and 32mm models. Tested on my Bambu Lab A1 Mini.

item.title: Real-World Objects to 32mm Scale: Feet to MM Conversion (The Math Explained)
item.description: The formula I use to convert real-world heights to 32mm miniature scale. Charts for humans, horses, monsters, and terrain for Warhammer, D&D, and Bolt Action.

item.title: Upscaling 3D Prints: How Big Can You Enlarge a 32mm Miniature Before Losing Detail?
item.description: How much can you enlarge a 32mm miniature on FDM before losing detail? Layer line visibility, nozzle settings, and slicer tips for clean upscaling on my Bambu Lab A1 Mini.

item.title: How to Scale Miniatures in Chitubox & Lychee Slicer (Without Messing Up the Base)
item.description: Step-by-step guide to scaling STL files in Chitubox and Lychee. Lock aspect ratios, scale without stretching the base, and understand the unit conversion — from my own slicer.

item.title: Why Miniature Scales Use a 175cm Human Baseline
item.description: Most tabletop miniature scales are built around a 175cm (5'9) human. Here is why I chose that number for every STLACCESS scale conversion.
